cover_letter:
Dear Donaldson Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Digital Marketing Internship opportunity with Donaldson Company, as advertised. Your commitment to solving complex filtration challenges and fostering innovation deeply resonates with my professional aspirations. I am particularly drawn to the prospect of joining your Mobile Solutions Aftermarket Marketing team in Leuven, contributing to a B2B business that keeps the world moving.

My experience as a Junior Digital Marketer and Web & SEO Specialist has equipped me with a practical skill set directly relevant to the responsibilities outlined. I have actively managed on-page SEO, conducted keyword research, and crafted SEO-driven content for client websites, consistently tracking performance using tools like Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console. My work involved comprehensive CMS content management, publishing and updating website pages, blog posts, and media, ensuring content remains current and effective. For example, I built and maintained a WordPress site for a pharmacists’ association, overseeing a consistent layout for around 600 member profiles, which highlights my structured and detail-oriented approach to content and asset organization.

The prospect of improving Donaldson’s marketing asset library and assisting with campaign planning and execution across EMEA excites me. I am adept at creating and adapting content for various digital channels and have a proven ability to assist with website updates, landing pages, and digital campaign assets. My background in developing and optimizing websites, combined with certifications in Google Analytics and Content Marketing, prepares me to contribute effectively to performance reporting and marketing materials that are easy for sales teams and distributors to use.

My technical background, bridging SEO, web development, and AI tools for automation, aligns uniquely with the challenge of marketing technical products in an engaging way. I am fluent in English, proactive, hands-on, and eager to apply my curiosity and reliability within an international team. This internship, lasting at least three months, represents an invaluable opportunity to learn from an experienced team and make meaningful contributions to your global marketing efforts.

Thank you for considering my application. I am available at your earliest convenience to discuss how my skills and enthusiasm can benefit Donaldson.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
- Experienced in comprehensive CMS content management, including publishing, updating, and structuring content for client websites, directly supporting the goal of improving marketing asset libraries.
- Proven ability in on-page SEO, keyword research, and creating SEO-driven blog content for B2B client websites, with measurable tracking using Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs.
- Developed and optimized multi-page WordPress websites, implementing structured data (JSON-LD schema) and knowledge-graph markup, demonstrating a strong technical foundation for web and digital asset management.
- Fluent in English with a background in supporting digital initiatives for large organizations and remote work, indicating comfort with international and B2B environments.
- Certified in SEO Fundamentals, SEO Toolkit, Google Analytics (GA4), and Content Marketing, eager to apply a structured and proactive approach to digital marketing challenges.
